basic_info.description: Opportunity Knocks in Miraloma Park at the border of Glen Park!! This charming home with Art Deco influence was in the same family for over 50 years and is ready for someone else to enjoy it as they did. It features wood floors, multiple skylights and Art Deco-inspired details. On the main floor: formal living with fireplace, dining, eat-in kitchen, 2 nicely sized bedrooms and full bath w stall shower and soaking tub. One level down a bonus room that could function as 3rd bedroom with full bath. Laundry room and access to garage is also on this level.  Lower level has office/den with radiant heat and a half bath (non-warranted) plus additional storage room formerly used as a dark room. Deck to the back yard adjoins this room with views of Glen Canyon.  A greenhouse comes with the garden. A large garage offers additional storage. Located near Glen Canyon Park, shops, BART, with close transit & freeway access. This home is being sold As Is. Photos to follow.
